Image 2 is the same species' refined T4 sprite and is ONLY a guide to crisp thick outlines, simple shading and clean large color blocks. ﻿Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset: Pyrodaemon UR T4 game creature sprite, conservative refinement.
Image 1 is the exact identity, anatomy, pose, palette and drawing-style edit target. Preserve its compact chibi three-headed fire hound: one large central head looking slightly upward with assured expression, smaller left head with tongue showing, smaller right head barking with open jaw. Keep exactly THREE heads on one stocky short-legged four-legged body. Keep head placement and characterful different expressions; each face must remain readable and distinct. Preserve pointed dark ears, cream muzzles and chests, dark blue-black body, the one broad dark purple collar with a few large pale studs, short stout paws with fire-red cuffs, curved fire-tipped tail, and red/orange/yellow flame mantle sweeping behind the heads.
Retain the original's bold dark colored cartoon outline, expressive simple face shapes, big deliberate flat color blocks and only a few cel-shaded shadow shapes. Clean up soft source edges at higher resolution and clarify overlaps between the three heads, necks and front paws. Keep the same squat proportions and pose; make existing planted paws and confident central gaze read clearly. Its UR authority comes from a strong unified silhouette, THREE contrasting expressions and broad clean flames, not extra detail.
Do not turn it into a realistic Cerberus or an adult wolf. No long legs, enlarged realistic muscles, new horns, extra heads, additional collars, intricate armor, realistic fur, strands, textures, metallic shine, gradient shading, glossy 3D lighting, particles, scattered flame fragments, floating rings or scenery. Keep approximately the same visual complexity as the original.
Full creature, entire three heads, paws, flames and tail visible. Centered, three-quarter right-facing view matching source, generous 8 percent clear margin. Transparent background, remove the source ground shadow, no text or watermark. One sprite only.

﻿Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset: Meteorax UR T4 game creature sprite, conservative refinement.
Image 1 is the exact identity, anatomy, pose, palette and drawing-style edit target. Preserve this compact stocky upright chibi stone dinosaur: huge low broad hind feet planted apart, small raised forearms, thick brown armored body, ivory belly with broad zigzag bands, heavy brow and upward right-facing snout, one visible angular violet/cyan eye, one curved tail with lightning-like cyan/violet pattern, and the dominant large lilac/cyan crystalline plates fanning upward along its back behind the head. Preserve the source's footprint, proportions and three-quarter right-facing stance.
Faithfully reproduce its bold dark brown/violet outline, simple hand-drawn cartoon shapes, large brown stone color blocks, pale ivory belly, and few flat shadow colors. Clean up contours, the boundary of brow and eye, the separation of small forearms from shoulder plates, and the silhouettes of the already-large hind feet. Give the existing stance a clear sense of weight without changing its compact proportions. Crystal plates keep the SAME count and broad readable outlines with only two or three large lilac/cyan flat facets each, not many tiny reflective fragments. Retain the source's clean cyan seam accents sparingly.
It should feel like the original game's artist has made a slightly cleaner, more assured version of the SAME sprite. No realistic dragon or kaiju, new horns, wings, gold jewelry, added armor rows, additional floating crystals, rocks, particles or orbit rings. No realistic rock textures, tiny cracks, extra facets, gradients, bloom, glossy 3D material, painterly lighting or fur. Do not replace its shape language with a detailed fantasy illustration.
Full creature, all crystal tips, forearms, hind feet and tail visible. Centered, matching source angle, at least 8 percent clear margin. Transparent background, no ground shadow, no text or watermark. One sprite only.

﻿Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset: Stormlion SSR T4 game sprite, restrained art correction study.
Input image 1 is the edit target AND the sole style reference. Preserve its exact character design, compact chibi proportions, oversized head, small short body and legs, airborne charging pose, three-quarter right-facing angle, lightning mane silhouette, round dark ears, cream muzzle, curled tail, original orange/yellow/cream palette, and thick warm dark outlines. This original has intentional graphic shape design: reproduce its flat 2D cartoon drawing language faithfully.
Make only a subtle confidence adjustment to the brow and gaze, and clarify the overlap of the visible front paws. Keep the playful personality. Carefully clean the existing contours and large color boundaries at higher resolution while retaining their original expressive character. Keep approximately the same number of shapes and the same very limited flat shadow colors as the original. Preserve the large cream lightning shapes and simple orange markings, without extra subdivisions. The result should feel like the same artist making a small deliberate refinement of the same sprite.
Do not lengthen the legs or body, enlarge the chest, change into a realistic adult lion, add fur strands, narrow the outline, add complex facets, gradients, rim lighting, glow, sparkle, rings, armor, props, extra spikes, or new decorations. No painterly rendering, glossy 3D volumes, or polished fantasy illustration treatment. Do not invent details in the original's flat color areas. Keep the total visual complexity extremely close to the input.
One complete creature, entire mane and tail visible, centered, 8 percent clear margin. Transparent background, no ground shadow, no scenery, no text or watermark.

﻿Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset: Stormlion SSR T4, awakened 95 percent purity preview.
Input image 1 is the approved normal T4 edit target and sole style reference. Preserve the exact drawing: compact chibi proportions, enormous head, small body and short legs, charging pose, right-facing angle, lightning mane shapes, ears, tail, paws, bold dark brown contour, flat orange/yellow/cream color areas. Keep the same simple two-dimensional cartoon technique and minimal cel shading.
Make just ONE tiny change: give the visible eye a warm amber iris with one crisp small white glint, creating a subtly alert awakened gaze. Preserve the eyelid and brow shapes and their personality. Everything else remains visually the same. This is a subtle awakening of normal T4, not an alternate skin or another evolution. Do not add decorations, change mane size, change anatomy, add fur strands, fine textures, gradients, glow, realistic lighting, rings, or painterly rendering.
One complete creature, transparent background, no shadow, no text or watermark, leave at least 8 percent clear margin.

﻿Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset: Stormlion SSR T4, perfect 100 percent purity alternate appearance study, named Platinum Thunder King.
Input image 1 is the approved normal T4 edit target AND the sole drawing-style reference. Preserve its exact compact chibi proportions, oversized head, short legs, charging pose, three-quarter right-facing angle, cheek and muzzle shapes, round ears, tail shape, paws and bold warm dark contour. Same species and same T4 anatomy, not an extra evolution. Match the simple flat 2D cartoon linework with large intentional color blocks and just one shadow color per material.
Create a distinctive but restrained perfect-form alternate skin with these coordinated changes only:
1. Recolor the small orange body and paws to deep charcoal brown / dark plum-brown fur, with a small warm amber chest area. Keep the cream muzzle and the warm cream central face recognizable. Flat color blocks, no fur texture.
2. Preserve the mane's existing large zigzag silhouette and the SAME number of major lightning blades. Change its orange-yellow fur areas to platinum ivory with a single pale gold shadow. The existing cream lightning blades become clear pale gold with warm amber outlines. A strong simple ivory-and-gold mane against dark short body gives an immediately distinct, legible royal appearance.
3. Replace only the existing single forehead lightning crest with one compact integrated three-pronged thunder crest, ivory edges and a flat amber core. Keep it about the same size as the original crest. The three broad branches form a clean species-specific symbol, not a crown accessory. Use an amber eye with a single crisp white glint; retain the original gaze and expression.
Keep the mane less visually busy than the source, not more. No new small spikes, no floating halo, ring, ornaments, armor, sparkles, particle background, fur strands, gradients, reflective metal, glossy material, dramatic rim lighting, painterly rendering or realistic adult lion anatomy. This is a simple expressive cartoon sprite in the exact same artist's hand as input 1.
One complete creature, transparent background, no ground shadow, no text or watermark, at least 8 percent clear margin. No additional characters or before-and-after layout.

This is a purity variant of T4, not a fifth evolution. No glossy rendering, gradients, armor, jewelry, floating rings, scene, text, UI, particles or watermark. Full paws, ears and tail visible, generous transparent padding.
Variant: 95% purity, awakened. Make an extremely restrained edit: the middle head's iris becomes a clearer rich molten amber with its existing tiny white highlight; replace the central collar stud with a small flat amber-gold stud, preserving size and collar design; add just a small warm ivory highlight inside the existing golden flame behind the middle head, under 3% of total sprite area. Keep the existing crimson/orange/golden fire silhouette, all dark segmentation and palette unchanged everywhere else. At least 95% visually identical to edit target. Do not inflate the fire mane, do not recolor all flames.

This must feel intentionally designed and more distinguished than normal T4, while keeping the same charming compact three-headed dog. Change only the flame mane, flame accents and collar studs. Reshape the mane into THREE clear dominant, swept-back flame tongues corresponding to the three heads; the middle flame sits highest. Together they suggest a natural flame crown, not a physical crown or a huge circular fireball. Preserve substantial dark-navy clefts between tongues and limit mane area to approximately the original. Make this silhouette noticeable even at 96px.
